# solid-v1.0

Solid-block preset: thin diagonal lines joined and drawn as bands, local staircase smoothing,
bands clipped at line ends, weak soft band (0.3) so seam junctions stay sharp.

Status: **superseded** (replaced by a newer version, kept so older packs can be rebuilt)  
Changes in this version: First solid preset: lines as bands, local staircase smoothing, clipped bands, weak soft band.  
Based on: [base-v1.0](base-v1.0.md)  
Built on this: [solid-v1.1](solid-v1.1.md)  

Not used by any built-in profile (pick it with `--blocks`, `--items` or `--use`).

## What it changes

Compared with base-v1.0:

| option | base-v1.0 | solid-v1.0 |
|---|---|---|
| `diag_join` | `False` | `True` |
| `join_thin_only` | `False` | `True` |
| `stair_local` | `False` | `True` |
| `keep_dither` | `True` | `False` |
| `line_field` | `False` | `True` |
| `line_strength` | `1.05` | `0.3` |
| `line_contrast` | `0.1` | `0.05` |
| `line_clip` | `False` | `True` |
